issues.detail: Instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as failed uploads or invalid credentials.
Skill relies on Node SDK and Next.js, limiting applicability to other platforms.

scenarios.name: responsive-srcset
scenarios.rationale: Response A lacks any Cloudinary logic or srcset generation, while Response B provides a Cloudinary-based function and srcset string but omits the required dpr='auto' parameter.

scenarios.name: signed-upload-endpoint
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully meets the rubric by using Cloudinary's signing method and returning the required fields, while Response A describes an S3 solution unrelated to Cloudinary.

scenarios.name: nextjs-image-component
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets all rubric requirements; Response B does not use CldImage and thus fails.
